location.name: The landing

view.text: The streetlamp has a man under it, between you and the office door. He is looking at you.
The streetlamp burns over empty cobbles. The office door is shut.

location.asset: He turns as you come up. It is the face from the folder, and it is only a face. He goes down past you into the fog without hurry.
Where Penry said he would be. He turns, the face from the folder, and goes down past you into the fog. The door is clear.
You stand under the lamp. His name is not on the board, and not in the chalk. It is in your coat, and nowhere else tonight.
You stand under the lamp. The cobbles stay empty. The door waits.
A dark window with the curtain drawn back a hand's width. Whoever watched the lamp tonight saw what you saw, and has not gone to bed.
Wet prints come in with you. Green light lies under the office door. The dry room is on the other side.
Midnight. The door opens on the room. Edith looks up from the chair, and does not stand.
location.ending: You read his hour under the lamp. He is beside you before the line is done, and the office door is further than it was.
